description: Test suite for WebSocket frame header and payload functions in the net/websockets namespace, including frame length encoding, masking, opcodes, and validation.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a WebSocket frame, including opcode, payload length, masking, and reserved bits.

methods.name: WriteWebSocketFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebSocketFrameHeader into a buffer, considering masking and payload length.

methods.name: MaskWebSocketFramePayload
methods.description: Applies masking or unmasking to WebSocket frame payload data based on the masking key and frame offset.
